description: The best WYSIWYG editor! HugeRTE is an open source platform independent web based Javascript HTML WYSIWYG editor control forked by the HugeRTE contributors from the latest MIT-licensed version of the TinyMCE editor released by Tiny Technologies, Inc. HugeRTE has the ability to convert HTML TEXTAREA fields or other HTML elements to editor instances. HugeRTE is very easy to integrate into other Content Management Systems.
summary: HugeRTE is a platform independent web based Javascript HTML WYSIWYG editor control released as Open Source under MIT.
